items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And Pops would sit around and tell stories and we would jam right there in the street

ctx.x: Oh, another movie that I did at Paramount Studios with Louis Armstrong and Mae West. Now I don't know the name of that movie, but that was the one where I wrote the drum parts for it because they wanted it to be a march, but they wanted to have the feel of 4/4 type of thing. And I'll never forget -- we were doing these things; we were shooting like, we started at 11 o'clock at night. It had to be a night scene

and we'd go until morning. And Pops would sit around and tell stories and we would jam right there in the street; it was a street scene over there in Paramount. But it was a Mae West picture, but I don't know the name of it.

And another time that I worked with Hazel, they did another movie, it was something about -- they did a tune for her, "when the black keys meet the white keys ..." and something; right now, that particular type of song would be termed as corny, but I can't remember all those movies, really, but I did an awful lot of movies. Awful lot of movies.
